verdict.rationale: E2B is an API/SDK platform, so API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versions, versioning schemes, or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path tried, and the SDK and CLI docs say nothing on the subject.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
